title: The Mbira Knows (Zimbabwe Family)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk prominent thumb piano urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone vocal 80bpm analog tape warm ancestral Shona spiritual
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The mbira doesn't need translation
It speaks in frequencies older than the words
The thumb piano says what the voice can't reach
In a register only the ancestors heard

[Verse 2]
When the farm was full the mbira played celebration
When the rains were late it played patience
When the family left for the airport gate
The mbira played both departure and return at the same time

[Chorus]
The mbira knows
What the words leave out
The mbira knows
What the heart is about
When the red dust settles and the hosho fades
The mbira knows — the mbira always played

[Bridge — mbira instrumental section]
The thumb finds the tine
The tine finds the note
The note finds the chest
The chest finds the throat
And the throat finds the word
That was there all along
The mbira knows the word
The mbira is the song

[Verse 3]
Kerri brought it to Australia in her body
In the way she quiets when the music starts
In the way Ari pauses before she sings
That half-second — that's the mbira, that's the knowing

[Outro]
The mbira knows
The mbira knows
Zimbabwe lives in the note
The mbira knows
